title: The 'Aldric's Ring' quest completed via a ledger check at the Company Store (Cinderhall), but I still carried the physical 'Aldric's iron ring' item for the rest of the game with no dialogue option to actually hand it to Corporal Fenn — talking to him only offered a debt-info line, not an item-delivery line, leaving the item's purpose unresolved.
where: The Company Store (Cinderhall) / Corporal Fenn at Highward's Barracks
